plugins.name: oryn
plugins.description: AI short-video production: a topic or product link becomes a finished vertical video (script → free stock footage → free TTS → captions → BGM → FFmpeg compose), keyless by default. Installs the oryn-video skill plus the Oryn MCP server (oryn_create_video, oryn_product_script, oryn_gate …) targeting your local Oryn instance.
